solution_summary: Providing the best market intelligence while protecting data privacy has always been the Foxintelligence vision. And in handling consumers' personal data, the business has to comply with the European Union's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), as well as regulation in other countries and regions as it expands operations globally. "We know we have a lot of security features on the AWS platform. We know it's a place where we can store data and protect data," says Amichia. Advice from the AWS engineering team also helps Foxintelligence understand how to use new features to meet compliance requirements as regulation evolves. "Data protection is a core value at Foxintelligence," says Amichia, "and AWS provides really good support for that."
